event_summary: A hanging black kettlebell and a hanging green sheet move downward onto two pillows, producing visible shape changes at the contact areas.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with two light gray pillows resting side by side on a wooden surface. A black kettlebell hangs above the left pillow, and a bright green sheet hangs above the right pillow from a dark vertical support. Both hanging objects descend. The kettlebell reaches the top of the left pillow and remains seated against it while the pillow top visibly indents and wrinkles near the contact area. The green sheet descends onto the right pillow, bends into a curved shape, and then lies partly against the pillow surface while its hanging support remains above it. The camera view remains fixed throughout.

reasons: Two pillows, the hanging kettlebell, and the hanging green sheet are visible before contact.
The supporting vertical elements are partly visible above the hanging objects.
The table surface and wall background are visible.
